title: Apply Security Patch
briefing: A vulnerability has been identified in a critical system component. Choose the correct command to apply the security patch.

feedback.apt update && apt upgrade: Correct. Updating package lists and applying upgrades is the standard approach to applying security patches on Debian-based systems.
feedback.apt install security-patch: Incorrect. This command assumes a specific package name that may not exist.
feedback.apt-get upgrade --security-only: Incorrect. This is not a standard command and would likely fail.
